title: Frenzy VR
description:
Frenzy VR is an action fighter all about destruction & interactive environments. You can use any object as a weapon with our advanced destruction physics for realistic mayhem. Frenzy VR includes a story mode with deep narrative secrets, levels, and objectives. Take the chaos into your own hands with free play modes allowing unlimited creativity across various maps like offices, apartments, prison, and more.

FULLY INTERACTIVE AND DESTRUCTIBLE WORLDSAll maps feature fully destructible items, objects, & enemies

RAGDOLL PHYSICS WITH MELEE / RANGED WEAPONSNPCs use realistic physics ragdolls for ultimate chaos and mayhem

STORY MODE WITH NARRATIVE AND CAMPAIGNComplete the full story with multiple missions and take down the Reborn Company

10+ REALISTIC MAPS AND MISSIONSGo ballistic in fully interactable worlds built specifically for you to destroy 

FULL WEAPON CUSTOMIZATION AND UPGRADESRealistic gun and melee weapon physics that feel just like real life

FIGHT VICIOUS AND CRAZY NPCSShow no mercy as you fight back against the corrupt NPCs

EXTRA MINIGAMES AND GAMEMODESYou'll never run out of things to do with our our infinitely replayable game modes & Mod Support!
description_short: A destruction and mayhem sandbox playground. Become immersed in the deep story that unfolds before you, with plenty of lore and secrets to uncover along the way. Play around with ragdoll enemies (including unique bosses) and cause chaos wherever you go.
